6.247 rsInvalidKeepWithGroupOnColumnTablixMember
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidKeepWithGroupOnColumnTablixMember is a critical error that will occur when a TablixMember
instance within the Tablix.TablixColumnHierarchy has TablixMember.KeepWithGroup set to a value
other than "None".
